short_description: Research-only panel-relative PGS signal for insomnia.
summary_note: This score estimates a cautious, research-only, reference-panel-relative genetic signal for insomnia.
what_it_measures: A polygenic score associated with Insomnia in PGS Catalog. It does not measure current symptoms, diagnosis, or clinical risk for this user.
interpretation_template: Insomnia research signal is shown as a research-only genetic signal, not a medical result, diagnosis, screening result, treatment recommendation, or lifestyle recommendation. {interpretation}
caution_text: Research-only genetic signal. This is not a diagnosis, medical advice, screening, treatment guidance, prevention guidance, or a substitute for a clinician. Results depend on raw-file coverage and the local reference panel.
limitations: This is not a diagnosis, medical advice, clinical screening, prevention guidance, or treatment guidance.
The score does not measure current symptoms, disease status, sleep quality, behavior, or future clinical risk for the user.
Reference distribution is built from local raw files and may be small or ancestry-biased.
No genotype imputation is used, so missing variants can affect the estimate.
confidence_note: Confidence depends on raw-file coverage and overlap with scoring variants; it is not clinical or behavioral certainty.
reference_note: Reference panel: local empirical panel from available Autosomal raw files, excluding bot staging folders.
